scientific_integrity: The original geometric parametrization, its birationality, degree and focal-base-locus facts are credited to Bolognesi, Ciliberto and Verra; only the smooth Fano graph theorem and its complete Chow/multidegree formula are advanced as additional claims. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
scientific_limitations: General alternating linear subsystems and general source hyperplanes over the complex numbers only; not every Pfaffian hypersurface or parametrization. Singularities of targets and other incidence models are not classified. Genericity and irreducibility use characteristic-zero Bertini; arithmetical checks are finite and do not prove these geometric statements.
title: Smooth Fano incidence graphs and complete multidegrees of Pfaffian parametrizations
